notes.title: Mercenary Kings Reloaded coming February 6th as a free update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/56f93c9ecd43513c20ec3445729023f2b640d00f.png[/img]

Here's a look at what's new in Mercenary Kings: Reloaded Edition:

[list]
[*][b]Two new playable characters[/b]

[b]Frigg:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/e847d4f245404d0b8fb8f809db1518295033aa51.png[/img]

[i]Frigg is a resistance fighter who has joined the Mercenary Kings to fight the forces of CLAW. No matter which weapon she carries, Frigg can jump faster than any other Kings thanks to her Olympic training![/i]

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/6c727a5338e9868db745043d2a2e959e8c7d2968.gif[/img]
 

[b]C-ZAR:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/ca05bb2a769289fbf0cc63e791437392e0fea05e.png[/img]
 
[i]C-Zar is a friendly automaton built by the Kings' communication expert Miss Zero. [/i]

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/4280451451c79603a37d5cd1cea1433d50da0581.gif[/img]

 
[*][b]New knives to craft![/b]

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/7dcf55025fe080c8e530c6f96c4f5c0858da92a2.gif[/img]
 
[*][b]New gun parts to craft![/b]

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/a597cabd1324226777b98767db2e2a09b43b2c16.gif[/img]

[/list]

Mercenary Kings: Reloaded Edition also features many other minor features and  improvements over the original release of the game, such as the ability to buy materials, stronger grenades, a menu previewing mission rewards, all mission objectives displayed on the mini map, tips displayed during loadings, and more. 

See you February 6th!

notes.title: New Update (r6465)
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelist for [b]r6465[/b]
[i]Fixes : [/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed enemy count bug in extermination zones (fixes Sewer Sharks and In Da House).
[*]Fixed infinite roll spot in Military City.
[*]Added missing materials in some empty crates.
[*]Added Resistance hostages texts.
[/list]

[i]Tweaks : [/i]
[list]
[*]Changed Magazine stats calculation (Power VS Capacity).
[*]Added more time to Rush N Retrieve and Extraction Prime missions.
[*]Tweaked sell price of supply items.
[*]Tweaked spawn distance of Patrol & Sniper bullets.
[*]Removed enemy respawn in Underground Passage of Spelunker.
[*]Tweaked size of boss shields in Operation Lights Out.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update (r6455)
notes.notes:
Changelist for [b]r6455[/b]
[i]Fixes : [/i]
[list]
[*]crash when selling an item currently displayed in the item selection wheel
[*]Having OpenAL not installed now remind you to repair the installation of the game
[*]if your video card does not support GL_ARB_FRAMEBUFFER_OBJECT from the OpenGL 3.0 specification, the game will tell you so (instead of crashing)
[*]posible fix for a crash when going back to title screen
[/list]

[i]Tweaks : [/i]
[list]
[*]nerfed fast reloader from 50% reduction to 20% (can stack twice for 40%)
[*]nerfed health regen skill from 1 HP / 1s to 1 HP / 3s
[/list]
